questions.q: What does the Dalai Lama see as humanity's missing trait?
questions.why: The overview says compassion is the limiting factor for our species.

questions.q: What question does lesson 1 say to ask when emotions rise?
a: How proportionate is this emotion to the situation?
Who is to blame for this?
questions.why: Lesson 1 suggests asking how well-proportioned your feelings are.

questions.q: What does lesson 1 say about controlling versus suppressing feelings?
a: Controlling helps decisions; suppressing causes outbursts
questions.why: The lesson says controlling feelings isn't suppressing them.

questions.q: Where does compassion come from, according to lesson 2?
a: It's an innate human trait grounded in biology
questions.why: Lesson 2 says compassion is separate from religion and rooted in biology.

questions.q: Which three principles guide putting compassion into action?
questions.why: Lesson 3 lists fairness, transparency and accountability.
